cases.schema:
spec:
  identity:
    atomic_ref: "cic:core:Identity@v0.2.0"
    kind: Demo
    namespace: "cic:demo"
    version: v1.0.0
  config_surface:
    aggregate_ref: "cic:core:ConfigSurface@v0.2.0"
    nodes:
      - name: type
        atomic_ref: "cic:core:Shape@v0.2.0"
        shape_type: scalar
        scalar_type: string
        mandatory: true
      - name: enabled
        shape_type: scalar
        scalar_type: boolean
        optional: true
        default: true
      - name: mtu
        shape_type: scalar
        scalar_type: integer
        optional: true
        default: 1500
        contract:
          - type: range
            expression: "68..9216"
      - name: ip
        shape_type: composite
        optional: true
        fields:
          - name: addresses
            shape_type: collection
            collection_variant: set
            item_scalar_type: string
            optional: true
            min_items: 1
          - name: gateway
            shape_type: scalar
            scalar_type: string
            optional: true
      - name: blob
        shape_type: opaque
        optional: true
      - name: routes
        shape_type: collection
        collection_variant: list
        optional: true
        item_fields:
          - name: to
            shape_type: scalar
            scalar_type: string
            role: key
          - name: metric
            shape_type: scalar
            scalar_type: integer
            optional: true
      - name: vlans
        shape_type: collection
        collection_variant: list
        optional: true
        min_items: 1
        item_choice:
          cases:
            - name: referenced
              key: [ref]
              fields:
                - name: ref
                  shape_type: scalar
                  scalar_type: string
                  role: key
            - name: inline
              key: [vlan_id]
              fields:
                - name: vlan_id
                  shape_type: scalar
                  scalar_type: integer
                  role: key
                - name: vlan_mode
                  shape_type: scalar
                  scalar_type: string
                  optional: true

documents.yaml:
type: physical
enabled: false
mtu: 9000
ip:
  addresses: [10.0.0.1/24]
  gateway: 10.0.0.254
blob:
  anything: [1, 2]
routes: []

type: x
routes:
  - to: 10.0.0.0/8
    metric: 5
  - to: 0.0.0.0/0

type: x
routes:
  - to: a
    foo: 1

type: x
routes:
  - to: a
    metric: ~
  - to: a

type: x
routes:
  - to: a
    metric: x

type: x
routes:
  - to: b
    metric: ~
  - to: a
    metric: ~

type: x
vlans:
  - ref: x
  - vlan_id: 100
    vlan_mode: trunk

type: x
vlans:
  - ref: x
    vlan_id: 1

type: x
vlans:
  - vlan_id: 10
    vlan_mode: ~
  - vlan_id: 9
    vlan_mode: ~
